attribute.expr: eval: def l = __repo__(RotationStock).all().filter('self.daysOfStock IS NOT NULL').fetch(); def v = (l.collect{ it.stockValue ?: 0 }.sum() ?: 0) as BigDecimal; v > 0 ?
